Container.Name: atvbridge
Container.Overview: Control an Apple TV from Android's built-in Google TV remote (Quick Settings tile / Google Home app): D-pad, keyboard, volume, mute and voice. The dashboard (WebUI) shows what's playing, pairs devices and hands out the Android companion app for the lock-screen media card. Includes a Siri voice remote: pair it once in Apple's Home app (Add Accessory, More options, Voice Remote, code 031-45-154) and the remote's mic button talks to Siri. Host networking is required (phones and the Apple TV find it over mDNS).
Container.Requires: Host networking. An Apple TV on the same network.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Pairings (Apple TV, phones, Siri remote), settings and the speech model cache.

Config.Name: Dashboard port
Config.Description: Port of the dashboard and the companion app's connection (host network).

Config.Name: Advertised IP
Config.Description: Leave empty. Set to the server's LAN IP only if the logs show phones being told the wrong address (several interfaces or bridges).

Config.Name: Siri voice remote
Config.Description: auto: run the bundled Siri voice remote (HomeKit). 0: turn it off.

Config.Name: Siri HomeKit setup code
Config.Description: Code to enter in the Home app when adding the Voice Remote.

Config.Name: Speech model
Config.Description: Local speech recognition used when Siri isn't available. small.en is more accurate but slower. Downloaded once (~140 MB).

Config.Name: Online artwork
Config.Description: 1: look up artwork for apps that publish none (YouTube thumbnails, App Store icons). 0: off.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: INFO, or DEBUG to log key presses and protocol messages.
